title: Optional column keys can make array_multisort inputs differ in length

ground_truth.statement: array_column omits rows missing the requested y field. Sorting that column together with all original rows can therefore give arrays of different lengths; array_multisort throws ValueError for that legal parameter value. Fully populated controls sort correctly.

provenance.derivation: Kept optional y and the two-array sort; removed irrelevant fields and proved the omitted-key failure.

notes: A valid-provider parsing example is not a correctness oracle. All three pinned tools are silent, retained as FN for the proven optional-column length hazard. No claim is made that their documented scope promises relational length analysis.
